## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
Confirm labeling-only scope, independent per-label evaluation, permissions, explicit manual exclusion/reset behavior, target-removal policy, input limits and chunk-marker precision. Review the generation transaction design and the provisional classification threshold. Use the existing Decision model; no new model selector is planned. Record intentional changes to existing test behavior before touching assertions.
Files: Review docs/architecture.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/services/ingestion.md, docs/services/agent.md, docs/services/system-config.md; no production edits.

## Tests to add before implementation
representative chunks where Security applies, Architecture applies, both apply, neither applies, and borderline probabilities. Verify supported boolean-evaluation fixtures and threshold boundaries. Mock only provider HTTP. Update this Page and Beadwork contract issue; no production implementation in the gate.
Immediate unit/integration/property/LiveView tests apply. New feature E2E waits for human UX approval; changing existing test behavior requires explicit approval.

## Branches/paths validated
representative chunks where Security applies, Architecture applies, both apply, neither applies, and borderline probabilities. Verify supported boolean-evaluation fixtures and threshold boundaries. Mock only provider HTTP. Update this Page and Beadwork contract issue; no production implementation in the gate.
Preserve manual document inclusion/exclusion across re-ingestion; replace all chunk assignments. Missing Decision configuration skips automatic labeling.

## Mocking plan
Use real Repo, permissions, domain contexts, Action validation and dispatch wherever practical. Control only external model/embedding/conversion/provider HTTP and genuine nondeterministic boundaries. Runtime opts use Zaq.Config.get/4. No broad global mocks or sleep-based coordination. Review/approval-only steps need no mocks.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
docs/services/ingestion.md and affected module docs; docs/architecture.md for approved cross-role/generation boundaries. Keep this Page's final specification aligned; progress remains in Beadwork.

## Action reuse assessment
Review-only gate; approve classification contracts and reuse decisions before implementation.

## Validation and prerequisites
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle, docs/testing-approach.md and docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md. All cross-service BO calls use NodeRouter.dispatch/1 and explicit Event action. No commit/push/merge authorized. Dependencies follow the three-PR sequence in the parent issue; only task 1 is initially ready.
## Feature E2E and approval tracking
Human UX: zaq-kw0.15; consolidated feature E2E: zaq-kw0.16; contract gate: zaq-kw0.1; review/coverage: zaq-kw0.17; final validation: zaq-kw0.18.

Current scope: category labeling only. Independent boolean decisions permit multiple labels. Manual add/remove overrides automation; reset releases control. No free-text extraction or summarization.
## PR ownership and completion
PR 1. PR 1 ships manual behavior only. Test server rejection of automatic settings and reset, supported typed chunk contracts without preview, stable manual document retention and chunk assignment cascade. Automatic reset/model-readiness cases become executable in PR 2 task 7; chunk-position UI cases in PR 3 task 14.
Immediate unit/integration/LiveView tests and owning documentation ship in this PR. Completion gate: zaq-kw0.19. Apply review, coverage and final validation separately per PR. Persistent feature E2E zaq-kw0.16 remains blocked by UX zaq-kw0.15; earlier PRs explicitly report deferred E2E.
